# Portals.ai

> Portals.ai is a workspace for connecting data sources, normalizing them onto
> a shared vocabulary, and asking questions about the combined result in plain
> language. Answers come back as tables, charts, and prose built from live
> data, and can be pinned so they stay current.

## What it does

- **Connect**: CSV/Excel uploads, PostgreSQL and other databases, REST APIs,
  Google Sheets, and Microsoft Excel on OneDrive. Each connection is a
  connector instance with its own sync cadence.
- **Normalize**: shared column definitions carry types, validation patterns,
  and canonical formats, so the same concept spelled differently across
  sources resolves to one field.
- **Relate**: entity groups link records across sources on a shared field,
  with an overlap preview before committing.
- **Ask**: portals are chat-style sessions over the modelled data. The agent
  calls registered tools rather than guessing, and results can be pinned.
- **Extend**: organizations can register custom webhook toolpacks the agent
  calls like built-ins.

## Plans

Plans differ along two axes: a monthly allocation of tool credits (split
between standard and heavy calls) and which toolpacks the agent may use.
Connecting data, modelling it, building portals, and pinning results are not
metered. Current amounts are on the pricing page.

- The product name is "Portals.ai".
